translations.literal: At first he delighted in poetry; from ancient songs and ballads through the three hundred Odes, Han, Wei, the Six Dynasties, and Tang, he shaped his forms and refined his spirit in all, producing three thousand poems.
translations.idiomatic: At first he delighted in poetry; from ancient songs through the Odes, Han, Wei, the Six Dynasties, and Tang, he shaped his forms and refined his spirit in all, producing three thousand poems.

sentences.zh: 既，官禮部主事，兼軍機章京。

translations.literal: Afterward he served as secretary in the Ministry of Rites and concurrently as clerk in the Grand Council.
translations.idiomatic: Afterward he served as secretary in the Ministry of Rites and concurrently as clerk in the Grand Council.

sentences.zh: 旋補戶部主事，轉員外郎，改御史。

translations.literal: Soon he was made up as secretary in the Ministry of Revenue, then vice director, then transferred to censor.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was made up as secretary in the Ministry of Revenue, then vice director, then transferred to censor.

sentences.zh: 意氣蹈厲，其議論所許可，惟李德裕、張居正輩，徒為詞章士無當也。

translations.literal: Bold and high-spirited, those he approved in discussion were only figures like Li Deyu and Zhang Juzheng; mere men of letters he deemed useless.
translations.idiomatic: Bold and high-spirited, he approved only statesmen like Li Deyu and Zhang Juzheng; mere men of letters he deemed useless.

sentences.zh: 於是勇言事，未踰月，三上章。

translations.literal: He then boldly remonstrated; within a month he submitted three memorials.
translations.idiomatic: He then boldly remonstrated; within a month he submitted three memorials.

sentences.zh: 最後以言宗室尚書叱辱滿司官非國體，在已奉旨處分後，罷御史，回戶部，轉郎中。

translations.literal: Finally he memorialized that an imperial clansman, a director, had insulted Manchu officials of his ministry, which was not in the national interest; though he had already received imperial punishment, he was dismissed as censor and returned to the Ministry of Revenue as director.
translations.idiomatic: Finally he memorialized that an imperial clansman serving as director had insulted Manchu officials of his ministry—an affront to the state; though already punished by imperial edict, he was dismissed as censor and returned to the Ministry of Revenue as director.

sentences.zh: 是時英吉利擾海疆，求通市。

translations.literal: At the time England was disturbing the coast and seeking trade.
translations.idiomatic: At the time England was harassing the coast and seeking trade.

sentences.zh: 鵬已黜，不得言事，猶條上三十事於尚書轉奏，報聞。

translations.literal: Peng had already been demoted and could not remonstrate, yet he still submitted thirty items in detail to the director for forwarding; the court acknowledged receipt.
translations.idiomatic: Though demoted and unable to remonstrate directly, Peng still submitted thirty detailed proposals through his director for forwarding; the court acknowledged receipt.

sentences.zh: 鵬負才氣，鬱不得施，乃著之言，為浮邱子一書。

translations.literal: Peng, talented and proud, could not deploy his gifts; he thereupon wrote a book called the Master of Floating Hill.
translations.idiomatic: Talented and proud, Peng could not deploy his gifts; he thereupon wrote a book called the Master of Floating Hill.

sentences.zh: 立一意為幹，一幹而分數支，支之中又有支焉，支干相演，以遞於無窮。

translations.literal: He set up one idea as the trunk; one trunk divided into several branches, and within branches there were branches again; branch and trunk evolved in succession to infinity.
translations.idiomatic: He set up one idea as the trunk; one trunk divided into branches, and within branches there were branches again; branch and trunk evolved in succession without end.

sentences.zh: 大抵言軍國利病，吏治要最，人事情偽，開張形勢，尋躡要眇，一篇數千言者九十餘篇，最四十餘萬言。

translations.literal: Broadly speaking he treated military and state profit and loss, the essentials of official governance, and human affairs true and false; opening out situations and pursuing essentials, more than ninety pieces of several thousand words each, totaling more than four hundred thousand words in all.
translations.idiomatic: Broadly speaking he treated military and fiscal affairs, the essentials of governance, and human affairs true and false; opening out situations and pursuing essentials, more than ninety chapters of several thousand words each, totaling more than four hundred thousand words.

sentences.zh: 每遇人輒曰：「能過我一閱浮邱子乎？」

translations.literal: Whenever he met anyone he would say: "Can you get through my Master of Floating Hill?"
translations.idiomatic: Whenever he met anyone he would say, "Can you get through my Master of Floating Hill?

sentences.zh: 其自喜如此。

translations.literal: He was so pleased with himself.
translations.idiomatic: Such was his self-satisfaction.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，卒。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year he died.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fourth year of Daoguang (1844) he died.

sentences.zh: 同時有張際亮者，亦以才氣磊落聞。

translations.literal: At the same time Zhang Jiliang was also famed for bold and open talent.
translations.idiomatic: At the same time Zhang Jiliang was also famed for bold, open talent.

sentences.zh: 際亮，字亨甫，建寧人。

translations.literal: Jiliang, styled Hengfu, was a native of Jianning.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Jiliang, styled Hengfu, was from Jianning.

sentences.zh: 少孤，伯兄業賈，以其才，資之讀書。

translations.literal: Orphaned young, his elder brother pursued trade but, seeing his talent, funded his studies.
translations.idiomatic: Orphaned young, his elder brother was a merchant but, seeing his talent, funded his studies.

sentences.zh: 補諸生，肄業福州鼇峰書院，院長陳壽祺器之。

translations.literal: Enrolled as a student, he studied at Fuzhou's Aofeng Academy, whose director Chen Shouqi valued him.
translations.idiomatic: Enrolled as a student, he studied at Fuzhou's Aofeng Academy, whose director Chen Shouqi valued him highly.

sentences.zh: 尋試拔貢，入京師，朝考報罷，而時皆嘖嘖稱其詩。

translations.literal: Soon he tested as a selected tribute student and entered the capital; the palace examination failed, yet all praised his poetry.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he tested as a selected tribute student and entered the capital; he failed the palace examination, yet all praised his poetry.

sentences.zh: 鹺使曾燠以事至，召之飲。

translations.literal: Salt commissioner Zeng Yu, passing through on business, summoned him to drink.
translations.idiomatic: Salt commissioner Zeng Yu, passing through on business, summoned him to drink.

sentences.zh: 燠以名輩自處，縱意言論，同坐贊服，際亮心薄之。

translations.literal: Yu held himself as a famed elder and spoke freely; those seated praised him, but Jiliang inwardly looked down on him.
translations.idiomatic: Yu held himself as a famed elder and spoke freely; those seated praised him, but Jiliang inwardly despised him.

sentences.zh: 燠食瓜子粘須，一人起為拈去，際亮大笑，眾慚。

translations.literal: Yu ate melon seeds that stuck to his beard; one man rose to pick them off, and Jiliang laughed loudly, shaming the company.
translations.idiomatic: Yu ate melon seeds that stuck to his beard; one man rose to pick them off, and Jiliang laughed loudly, shaming everyone present.

sentences.zh: 既罷，复投書責燠不能教後進，徒以財利奔走寒士門下。

translations.literal: After leaving, he again sent a letter rebuking Yu for failing to guide younger scholars and merely using wealth to court poor scholars at his gate.
translations.idiomatic: After leaving, he sent a letter rebuking Yu for failing to guide younger scholars and merely using wealth to court poor scholars at his gate.

sentences.zh: 燠怒，毀於諸貴人，由是得狂名，試輒不利。

translations.literal: Yu was angry and slandered him to various dignitaries; thereby he gained a reputation for eccentricity and repeatedly failed examinations.
translations.idiomatic: Yu was angry and slandered him to various dignitaries; thereby he gained a reputation for eccentricity and repeatedly failed examinations.

sentences.zh: 乃遍遊天下山川，窮探奇勝，以其窮愁慷慨牢落古今之意，發為詩歌，益沉雄悲壯。

translations.literal: He then traveled throughout the empire's mountains and rivers, exhaustively exploring wonders; with the spirit of poverty, sorrow, generosity, and the fallen grandeur of past and present, he composed poetry ever more somber, heroic, and tragic.
translations.idiomatic: He then traveled throughout the empire's mountains and rivers, exhaustively exploring wonders; channeling poverty, sorrow, generosity, and the fallen grandeur of past and present, he composed poetry ever more somber, heroic, and tragic.

sentences.zh: 十八年，鄉試者約：「張際亮狂士不可中。」

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year those taking the provincial examination agreed: "Zhang Jiliang is an eccentric and must not pass."
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year those taking the provincial examination agreed, "Zhang Jiliang is an eccentric and must not pass.

sentences.zh: 而際亮已易名亨輔，中式。

translations.literal: Yet Jiliang had already changed his name to Hengfu and passed.
translations.idiomatic: Yet Jiliang had already changed his name to Hengfu and passed.

sentences.zh: 拆卷，疑欲去之，副考官申解而止。

translations.literal: When the paper was opened they suspected fraud and wished to reject it; the associate examiner explained and they stopped.
translations.idiomatic: When the paper was opened they suspected fraud and wished to reject it; the associate examiner intervened and they desisted.

sentences.zh: 及來謁，果際亮也，主試者愕然。

translations.literal: When he came to pay his respects, it was indeed Jiliang; the chief examiner was astonished.
translations.idiomatic: When he came to pay his respects, it was indeed Jiliang; the chief examiner was astonished.

sentences.zh: 會試复報罷。

translations.literal: At the metropolitan examination he again failed.
translations.idiomatic: At the metropolitan examination he again failed.

sentences.zh: 際亮故與桐城姚瑩善。

translations.literal: Jiliang had long been friendly with Tongcheng's Yao Ying.
translations.idiomatic: Jiliang had long been friendly with Yao Ying of Tongcheng.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，聞瑩以守土事被誣下獄，入都急難。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year, hearing Ying was imprisoned on a charge of dereliction as territorial official, he entered the capital in urgent aid.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year, hearing Ying was imprisoned on a charge of dereliction as territorial official, he entered the capital to aid him urgently.

sentences.zh: 及事白而際亮疾篤，以所著思伯子堂詩集囑瑩，遂卒。

translations.literal: When the affair was cleared Jiliang was gravely ill; he entrusted his Sibozi Hall Poetry Collection to Ying and died.
translations.idiomatic: When the affair was cleared Jiliang was gravely ill; he entrusted his Sibozi Hall Poetry Collection to Ying and died.

sentences.zh: 其後瑩子濬昌輯而刊之，都三十二卷。

translations.literal: Later Ying's son Junchang compiled and published it in thirty-two fascicles.
translations.idiomatic: Later Ying's son Junchang compiled and published it in thirty-two fascicles.

sentences.zh: 龔鞏祚，原名自珍，字璱人，仁和人。

translations.literal: Gong Gongzuo, original name Zizhen, styled Seiren, was a native of Renhe.
translations.idiomatic: Gong Zizhen, original name Zizhen, styled Seiren, was from Renhe.

sentences.zh: 父麗正，進士，官蘇松兵備道，為段玉裁婿，能傳其學。

translations.literal: His father Lizheng was a jinshi, served as Suzhou-Songjiang circuit intendant for military affairs, was Duan Yucai's son-in-law, and could transmit his learning.
translations.idiomatic: His father Lizheng was a jinshi who served as Suzhou-Songjiang circuit intendant for military affairs; Duan Yucai's son-in-law, he transmitted Duan's learning.

sentences.zh: 鞏祚十二歲，玉裁授以說文部目。

translations.literal: At twelve Gongzuo was taught the Shuowen radical headings by Yucai.
translations.idiomatic: At twelve Zizhen was taught the Shuowen radical headings by Duan Yucai.

sentences.zh: 鞏祚才氣橫越，其舉動不依恆格，時近俶詭，而說經必原本字訓，由始教也。

translations.literal: Gongzuo's talent swept all before it; his conduct did not follow ordinary norms, at times approaching the bizarre, yet in expounding the classics he always grounded himself in original character glosses—from his first instruction.
translations.idiomatic: Zizhen's talent swept all before it; his conduct defied ordinary norms, at times approaching the bizarre, yet in expounding the classics he always grounded himself in original glosses—from his earliest instruction.

sentences.zh: 初由舉人援例為中書。

translations.literal: At first, as a provincial graduate, he entered the Secretariat by precedent.
translations.idiomatic: At first, as a provincial graduate, he entered the Secretariat by precedent.

sentences.zh: 道光時成進士，歸本班。

translations.literal: In the Daoguang reign he became a jinshi and returned to his original rank.
translations.idiomatic: In the Daoguang reign he became a jinshi and returned to his original rank.

sentences.zh: 洊擢宗人府主事，改禮部。

translations.literal: He was promoted to director in the Imperial Clan Court and transferred to the Ministry of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to director in the Imperial Clan Court and transferred to the Ministry of Rites.

sentences.zh: 謁告歸，遂不出。

translations.literal: He requested leave and returned home, and did not go out again.
translations.idiomatic: He requested leave, returned home, and never served again.

sentences.zh: 官中書時​​，上書總裁論西北塞外部落源流、山川形勢，訂一統誌之疏漏，凡五千言。

translations.literal: While a Secretariat compiler he memorialized the chief director on the origins of northwestern frontier tribes beyond the passes and the configuration of mountains and rivers, correcting lacunae in the Comprehensive Gazetteer—in all five thousand words.
translations.idiomatic: While a Secretariat compiler he memorialized the chief director on northwestern frontier tribes beyond the passes and the configuration of mountains and rivers, correcting lacunae in the Comprehensive Gazetteer—in all five thousand words.

sentences.zh: 後復上書論禮部四司政體宜沿革者，亦三千言。

translations.literal: Later he again memorialized on what should be reformed in the institutional framework of the four bureaus of the Ministry of Rites—also three thousand words.
translations.idiomatic: Later he memorialized on reforms needed in the four bureaus of the Ministry of Rites—another three thousand words.

sentences.zh: 其文字驁桀，出入諸子百家，自成學派。

translations.literal: His writing was fierce and unconventional, ranging through the masters and the hundred schools, forming a school of his own.
translations.idiomatic: His writing was fierce and unconventional, ranging through the masters and the hundred schools, forming a school of his own.

sentences.zh: 所至必驚眾，名聲藉藉，顧仕宦不達。

translations.literal: Wherever he went he startled the crowd; his fame spread widely, yet his official career did not prosper.
translations.idiomatic: Wherever he went he startled the crowd; his fame spread widely, yet his official career did not prosper.

sentences.zh: 年五十，卒於丹陽書院。

translations.literal: He died at fifty at the Danyang Academy.
translations.idiomatic: He died at fifty at the Danyang Academy.

sentences.zh: 著有尚書序大義、大誓答問、尚書馬氏家法、左氏春秋服杜補義、左氏決疣、春秋決事比、定菴詩文集。

translations.literal: His works include Great Meaning of the Preface to the Documents, Answers on the Great Declaration, Ma Family Method of the Documents, Supplementary Meaning to Du's Commentary on the Zuo Commentary, Resolution of Sores on the Zuo Commentary, Comparative Decisions on the Spring and Autumn, and the Ding'an Poetry and Prose Collection.
translations.idiomatic: His works include Great Meaning of the Preface to the Documents, Answers on the Great Declaration, Ma Family Method of the Documents, Supplementary Meaning to Du's Commentary on the Zuo Commentary, Resolution of Sores on the Zuo Commentary, Comparative Decisions on the Spring and Autumn, and the Ding'an Poetry and Prose Collection.

sentences.zh: 魯一同，字通甫，清河人。

translations.literal: Lu Yitong, styled Tongfu, was a native of Qinghe.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Yitong, styled Tongfu, was from Qinghe.

sentences.zh: 善屬文，師事潘德輿。

translations.literal: Skilled at literary composition, he studied under Pan Deyu.
translations.idiomatic: Skilled at literary composition, he studied under Pan Deyu.

sentences.zh: 道光十五年舉人。

translations.literal: A provincial graduate in the fifteenth year of Daoguang.
translations.idiomatic: A provincial graduate in the fifteenth year of Daoguang (1835).

sentences.zh: 時承平久，一同獨深憂，謂：「今天下多不激之氣，積而不化之習；

translations.literal: The age had long been at peace, yet Yitong alone was deeply troubled, saying: "Today the empire has much unaroused spirit and accumulated habits that do not transform;
translations.idiomatic: The age had long been at peace, yet Yitong alone was deeply troubled, saying, "Today the empire has much unaroused spirit and accumulated habits that do not transform;

sentences.zh: 在位者貪不去之身，陳說者務不駭之論。

translations.literal: those in office are greedy and will not leave their posts; those who remonstrate pursue opinions that will not startle.
translations.idiomatic: those in office are greedy and will not leave their posts; those who remonstrate pursue opinions that will not startle.

sentences.zh: 風烈不紀，一旦有緩急，莫可倚仗。」

translations.literal: Heroic integrity is unrecorded; once there is urgency, nothing can be relied upon."
translations.idiomatic: Heroic integrity goes unrecorded; once urgency comes, nothing can be relied upon.

sentences.zh: 既，再試不第，益研精於學。

translations.literal: Afterward he again failed the examinations and pursued his studies all the more deeply.
translations.idiomatic: Afterward he again failed the examinations and pursued his studies all the more deeply.

sentences.zh: 凡田賦、兵戎諸大政，及河道遷變、地形險要，悉得其機牙。

translations.literal: Whether land tax, military affairs, and other great policies, or changes in river courses and strategic terrain, he grasped their essentials.
translations.idiomatic: Whether land tax, military affairs, and other great policies, or changes in river courses and strategic terrain, he grasped their essentials.

sentences.zh: 為文務切世情，古茂峻厲，有杜牧、尹洙之風。

translations.literal: In writing he strove to address the age's realities; ancient, lush, stern, and forceful, he had the manner of Du Mu and Yin Zhu.
translations.idiomatic: In writing he strove to address the age's realities; ancient, lush, stern, and forceful, he had the manner of Du Mu and Yin Zhu.

sentences.zh: 漕督周天爵見之，曰：「天下大材也，豈直文字哉！」

translations.literal: Grain Transport Governor Zhou Tianjue, seeing him, said: "A great talent of the empire—not merely a man of letters!"
translations.idiomatic: Grain Transport Governor Zhou Tianjue, seeing him, said, "A great talent of the empire—not merely a man of letters!

sentences.zh: 曾國藩尤嘆異之。

translations.literal: Zeng Guofan especially marveled at him.
translations.idiomatic: Zeng Guofan especially marveled at him.

sentences.zh: 試禮部，入都，國藩數屏騶從就問天下事。

translations.literal: Testing at the Ministry of Rites and entering the capital, Guofan several times dismissed his mounted escort to ask him about affairs of the empire.
translations.idiomatic: Testing at the Ministry of Rites and entering the capital, Guofan several times dismissed his mounted escort to consult him on affairs of the empire.

sentences.zh: 粵逆踞金陵也，同年生吳棠方宰清河，一同為草檄，傳示列縣，辭氣奮發，江北人心大定。

translations.literal: When the Cantonese rebels held Nanjing, his fellow graduate Wu Tang was magistrate of Qinghe; Yitong drafted a proclamation for him to circulate among the counties—the language was stirring and hearts north of the Yangtze were greatly steadied.
translations.idiomatic: When the Taiping rebels held Nanjing, his fellow graduate Wu Tang was magistrate of Qinghe; Yitong drafted a proclamation for him to circulate among the counties—the language was stirring and hearts north of the Yangtze were greatly steadied.

sentences.zh: 江忠源師抵廬州，友人戴鈞衡為書通國藩之指，欲其起佐忠源。

translations.literal: When Jiang Zhongyuan's army reached Luzhou, his friend Dai Junheng wrote to communicate Guofan's intent, wishing him to rise and assist Zhongyuan.
translations.idiomatic: When Jiang Zhongyuan's army reached Luzhou, his friend Dai Junheng wrote to communicate Guofan's intent, wishing him to rise and assist Zhongyuan.

sentences.zh: 一同謝不出，復書極論用兵機宜，謂當緩金陵，專攻旁郡。

translations.literal: Yitong declined and stayed out; in reply he wrote at length on the opportune moments of employing troops, holding that Nanjing should be approached slowly while attacking neighboring prefectures in earnest.
translations.idiomatic: Yitong declined and stayed out; in reply he wrote at length on military strategy, holding that Nanjing should be approached slowly while neighboring prefectures were attacked in earnest.

sentences.zh: 其後大兵築長圍，期旦夕破金陵，一同獨決其必敗，未幾，果潰裂，蘇、浙淪陷。

translations.literal: Later the great army built a long encirclement, expecting to break Nanjing within days; Yitong alone judged it must fail. Before long it indeed collapsed in rout, and Jiangsu and Zhejiang fell.
translations.idiomatic: Later the great army built a long encirclement, expecting to break Nanjing within days; Yitong alone judged it must fail. Before long it collapsed in rout, and Jiangsu and Zhejiang fell.

sentences.zh: 已而國藩克安慶，復金陵，一如所論。

translations.literal: Later Guofan took Anqing and recovered Nanjing—exactly as he had argued.
translations.idiomatic: Later Guofan took Anqing and recovered Nanjing—exactly as he had argued.

sentences.zh: 同治二年，卒，年五十九。

translations.literal: In the second year of Tongzhi he died at the age of fifty-nine.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Tongzhi (1863) he died at the age of fifty-nine.

sentences.zh: 著邳州志、清​​河志、通甫類稿。

translations.literal: He authored the Gazetteer of Pei Prefecture, the Gazetteer of Qinghe, and the Tongfu Miscellany.
translations.idiomatic: His works include the Gazetteers of Pei and Qinghe and the Tongfu Miscellany.

sentences.zh: 子蕡，字仲實。

translations.literal: His son Fen, styled Zhongshi.
translations.idiomatic: His son Fen, styled Zhongshi.

sentences.zh: 諸生，文有家法。

translations.literal: A student, his writing had family method.
translations.idiomatic: A licentiate, his writing followed a rigorous family method.

sentences.zh: 善綜核，知府章儀林議減清河賦，苦繁重，叩蕡。

translations.literal: Skilled at comprehensive verification, Prefect Zhang Yilin proposed reducing Qinghe's land tax, which was painfully heavy; he consulted Fen.
translations.idiomatic: Skilled at comprehensive verification, Prefect Zhang Yilin proposed reducing Qinghe's land tax, which was painfully heavy, and consulted Fen.

sentences.zh: 蕡為剖析條目，退草三千言，明旦獻之。

translations.literal: Fen analyzed the items in detail, retired and drafted three thousand words, and presented it the next morning.
translations.idiomatic: Fen analyzed the items in detail, drafted three thousand words overnight, and presented it the next morning.

sentences.zh: 儀林驚喜，因請主辦，三年而成。

translations.literal: Yilin was astonished and delighted and thereupon asked him to take charge; in three years it was completed.
translations.idiomatic: Yilin was astonished and delighted and asked him to take charge; the work was completed in three years.

sentences.zh: 又佐修安東水道，役竣，費無毫髮溢。

translations.literal: He also assisted in repairing the Andong waterway; when the project was finished not a single cash was overspent.
translations.idiomatic: He also assisted in repairing the Andong waterway; when the project finished, not a single cash was overspent.

sentences.zh: 譚瑩，字玉生，南海人。

translations.literal: Tan Ying, styled Yusheng, was a native of Nanhai.
translations.idiomatic: Tan Ying, styled Yusheng, was from Nanhai.

sentences.zh: 弱冠應縣試，總督阮元遊山寺，見瑩題壁詩，驚賞，告縣令曰：「邑有才人，勿失之！」

translations.literal: In his youth he took the district examination; Governor-General Ruan Yuan, visiting a mountain temple, saw Ying's poem inscribed on the wall, was astonished and praised it, and told the magistrate: "The district has a talented man—do not lose him!"
translations.idiomatic: In his youth he took the district examination; Governor-General Ruan Yuan, visiting a mountain temple, saw Ying's poem on the wall, was astonished, and told the magistrate, "The district has a talented man—do not overlook him!

sentences.zh: 令問姓名，不答。

translations.literal: The magistrate asked his name; he would not answer.
translations.idiomatic: The magistrate asked his name; he would not answer.

sentences.zh: 已而得所為賦以告元，元曰：「是矣。」

translations.literal: Later he obtained a fu Ying had written and told Yuan; Yuan said: "This is he."
translations.idiomatic: Later he obtained a fu Ying had written and told Yuan; Yuan said, "This is he.

sentences.zh: 逾年，元開學海堂課士，以瑩及侯康、儀克中、熊景星、黃子高為學長。

translations.literal: The next year Yuan opened the Xuehai Hall to examine scholars, making Ying together with Hou Kang, Yi Kezhong, Xiong Jingxing, and Huang Zigao senior students.
translations.idiomatic: The next year Yuan opened the Xuehai Hall to examine scholars, appointing Ying together with Hou Kang, Yi Kezhong, Xiong Jingxing, and Huang Zigao as senior students.

sentences.zh: 瑩性強記，述往事，雖久遠，時日不失。

translations.literal: Ying had a powerful memory; narrating past events, however remote, he never missed the day.
translations.idiomatic: Ying had a powerful memory; narrating past events, however remote, he never missed a date.

sentences.zh: 博考粵中文獻，友人伍崇曜富於貲，為匯刻之，曰嶺南遺書五十九種，曰粵十三家集，曰楚南耆舊遺詩，益擴之為粵雅堂叢書。

translations.literal: He broadly examined Guangdong documents; his friend Wu Chongyao, rich in wealth, collected and printed them as fifty-nine works of Lingnan Survivals, Thirteen Guangdong Authors, and Survivor Poetry of Elders of Southern Chu, later expanding them as the Yueya Hall Collectanea.
translations.idiomatic: He broadly examined Guangdong documents; his wealthy friend Wu Chongyao collected and printed them as fifty-nine works of Lingnan Survivals, Thirteen Guangdong Authors, and Survivor Poetry of Elders of Southern Chu, later expanding them as the Yueya Hall Collectanea.

sentences.zh: 瑩為學長三十年，英彥多出其門。

translations.literal: Ying was senior student for thirty years; many outstanding men came from his gate.
translations.idiomatic: Ying served as senior student for thirty years; many outstanding scholars came from his school.

sentences.zh: 道光二十四年，舉於鄉，官化州訓導。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year of Daoguang he passed the provincial examination and served as instructor at Huazhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fourth year of Daoguang (1844) he passed the provincial examination and served as instructor at Huazhou.

sentences.zh: 久之，遷瓊州教授，加中書銜。

translations.literal: After a long while he was transferred to professor at Qiongzhou and given the rank of Secretariat compiler.
translations.idiomatic: After a long while he was transferred to professor at Qiongzhou and given the rank of Secretariat compiler.

sentences.zh: 少與侯康等交莫逆，晚歲陳澧與之齊名。

translations.literal: In youth he was intimate with Hou Kang and the like; in his later years Chen Li ranked with him in fame.
translations.idiomatic: In youth he was intimate with Hou Kang and others; in his later years Chen Li ranked with him in fame.

sentences.zh: 著樂志堂集。

translations.literal: He authored the Lezhi Hall Collection.
translations.idiomatic: His collected works survive as the Lezhi Hall Collection.

sentences.zh: 景星，字伯晴，亦南海人也。

translations.literal: Jingxing, styled Boqing, was also from Nanhai.
translations.idiomatic: Xiong Jingxing, styled Boqing, was also from Nanhai.

sentences.zh: 以詩見賞於元。

translations.literal: He won Yuan's praise through poetry.
translations.idiomatic: He won Yuan's praise through his poetry.

sentences.zh: 顧其意恨文士綿弱，學騎射技擊。

translations.literal: Yet he resented the softness of literary men and studied horsemanship, archery, and martial arts.
translations.idiomatic: Yet he resented the softness of literary men and studied horsemanship, archery, and martial arts.

sentences.zh: 以舉人終學官，無所試，一假書畫自娛。

translations.literal: Ending as an academician through the provincial degree, with no field to test himself, he amused himself solely with books and painting.
translations.idiomatic: Ending as an academician through the provincial degree, with no field to test himself, he amused himself with books and painting.

sentences.zh: 子高，字叔立，番禺人。

translations.literal: Zigao, styled Shuli, was a native of Panyu.
translations.idiomatic: Huang Zigao, styled Shuli, was from Panyu.

sentences.zh: 優貢生。

translations.literal: A senior tribute student.
translations.idiomatic: A senior tribute student.

sentences.zh: 精小篆，喜考證金石。

translations.literal: Expert in small seal script, he delighted in verifying bronzes and stones.
translations.idiomatic: Expert in small seal script, he delighted in verifying bronzes and stone inscriptions.

sentences.zh: 藏書多異本。

translations.literal: His book collection had many rare editions.
translations.idiomatic: His library held many rare editions.

sentences.zh: 瑩子宗浚，字叔裕。

translations.literal: Ying's son Zongjun, styled Shuyu.
translations.idiomatic: Ying's son Zongjun, styled Shuyu.

sentences.zh: 工駢文。

translations.literal: Skilled at parallel prose.
translations.idiomatic: He excelled at parallel prose.

sentences.zh: 同治十三年一甲二名進士，授編修。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year of Tongzhi, second in the first rank of the jinshi examination, he was appointed Compiler.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year of Tongzhi, second in the first rank of the jinshi examination, he was appointed Hanlin Compiler.

sentences.zh: 初舉於鄉，齒尚少。

translations.literal: When he first passed the provincial examination he was still young.
translations.idiomatic: When he first passed the provincial examination he was still young.

sentences.zh: 瑩課令讀書十年，乃許出仕。

translations.literal: Ying set him to read for ten years before permitting him to take office.
translations.idiomatic: Ying set him to read for ten years before permitting him to take office.

sentences.zh: 授以馬氏通考，略能記誦。

translations.literal: He was taught Ma Duanlin's Comprehensive Investigations and could recite it in outline.
translations.idiomatic: He was taught Ma Duanlin's Comprehensive Investigations and could recite it in outline.

sentences.zh: 既，入翰林，督學四川，又充江南副考官。

translations.literal: After entering the Hanlin he served as educational commissioner in Sichuan and also as associate examiner in Jiangnan.
translations.idiomatic: After entering the Hanlin he served as educational commissioner in Sichuan and also as associate examiner in Jiangnan.

sentences.zh: 以伉直為掌院所惡，出為雲南糧儲道。

translations.literal: Because of his upright bluntness he was hated by the Academy director and was sent out as grain commissioner in Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: Because of his blunt uprightness he was hated by the Academy director and was sent out as grain commissioner in Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 宗浚不樂外任，辭，不允。

translations.literal: Zongjun was unhappy with outside appointment and resigned, but was not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: Zongjun was unhappy with provincial appointment and resigned, but was not permitted.

sentences.zh: 再權按察使，引疾歸，鬱鬱道卒。

translations.literal: Twice acting surveillance commissioner, he pleaded illness and returned home, and died on the road in dejection.
translations.idiomatic: Twice acting surveillance commissioner, he pleaded illness and returned home, and died on the road in dejection.

sentences.zh: 吳敏樹，字本深，巴陵人。

translations.literal: Wu Minshu, styled Benshen, was a native of Baling.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Minshu, styled Benshen, was from Baling.

sentences.zh: 父達德，歲歉，貸貧民穀逾萬石，不償，有名湖、湘間。

translations.literal: His father Dade, in years of dearth, lent grain to the poor exceeding ten thousand piculs without repayment, famed between the lakes and the Xiang.
translations.idiomatic: His father Dade, in years of dearth, lent the poor more than ten thousand piculs of grain without seeking repayment, famed throughout Hunan.

sentences.zh: 敏樹生而好學，為文章力求岸異，刮去世俗之見。

translations.literal: Minshu loved learning from birth; in writing he strove for rugged difference and scraped away worldly views.
translations.idiomatic: Minshu loved learning from birth; in writing he strove for rugged originality and scraped away worldly views.

sentences.zh: 道光十二年，舉於鄉。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year of Daoguang he passed the provincial examination.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year of Daoguang (1832) he passed the provincial examination.

sentences.zh: 時梅曾亮倡古文義法京師，傳其師姚氏學說。

translations.literal: At the time Mei Cengliang was advocating the principles of ancient-style prose in the capital, transmitting his teacher Yao's doctrine.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Mei Cengliang was advocating ancient-style prose in the capital, transmitting his teacher Yao Nai's doctrine.

sentences.zh: 敏樹起湖湘，不與當世士接手，錄明崑山歸氏文成冊。

translations.literal: Minshu rose from the lakes and Xiang, not joining hands with men of the age, and copied the collected prose of Gui Youguang of the Ming.
translations.idiomatic: Minshu rose from Hunan, keeping aloof from contemporary circles, and copied the collected prose of Ming dynasty Gui Youguang.

sentences.zh: 既，入都，與曾亮語合。

translations.literal: After entering the capital he found agreement in speech with Cengliang.
translations.idiomatic: After entering the capital he found agreement with Cengliang.

sentences.zh: 於是京師盛傳敏樹能古文。

translations.literal: Thereupon the capital widely spread word that Minshu could write ancient-style prose.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon the capital widely spread word that Minshu could write ancient-style prose.

sentences.zh: 曾國藩官京師，與敏樹交最篤，既出治軍，欲使參幕事，辭不赴。

translations.literal: Zeng Guofan, while an official in the capital, was closest in friendship with Minshu; after leaving to command armies he wished to have him join his staff, but Minshu declined.
translations.idiomatic: Zeng Guofan, while an official in the capital, was closest in friendship with Minshu; after leaving to command armies he wished to have him join his staff, but Minshu declined.

sentences.zh: 敏樹貌溫而氣夷，意趣超曠，視人世忻戚得喪無累於其心。

translations.literal: Minshu's appearance was mild and his spirit tranquil; his interests were lofty and detached, and the joys and sorrows, gains and losses of the human world did not burden his heart.
translations.idiomatic: Minshu's appearance was mild and his spirit tranquil; his interests were lofty and detached, and worldly joys and sorrows did not burden his heart.

sentences.zh: 以大挑選瀏陽訓導，旋自免去。

translations.literal: In the large selection he was chosen as instructor at Liuyang and soon resigned of his own accord.
translations.idiomatic: In the large selection he was chosen as instructor at Liuyang and soon resigned of his own accord.

sentences.zh: 時登君山江樓，徜徉吟嘯。

translations.literal: He often ascended the Jiang Tower on Jun Mountain, wandering and chanting freely.
translations.idiomatic: He often ascended the Jiang Tower on Jun Mountain, wandering and chanting freely.

sentences.zh: 學者稱南屏先生。

translations.literal: Scholars called him Master Nanping.
translations.idiomatic: Scholars called him Master Nanping.

sentences.zh: 著柈湖文錄。

translations.literal: He authored the Panhu Literary Record.
translations.idiomatic: His collected works survive as the Panhu Literary Record.

sentences.zh: 卒，年六十九。

translations.literal: He died at sixty-nine.
translations.idiomatic: He died at sixty-nine.

sentences.zh: 敏樹之友以文名者，曰楊彝珍，字性農，武陵人。

translations.literal: Among Minshu's friends famed for writing was Yang Yizhen, styled Xingnong, a native of Wuling.
translations.idiomatic: Among Minshu's friends famed for writing was Yang Yizhen of Wuling, styled Xingnong.

sentences.zh: 父丕复，舉人，官石門訓導，著歷代輿地沿革。

translations.literal: His father Bufu was a provincial graduate, served as instructor at Shimen, and authored Changes in Territorial Administration Through the Dynasties.
translations.idiomatic: His father Bufu was a provincial graduate who served as instructor at Shimen and authored Changes in Territorial Administration Through the Dynasties.

sentences.zh: 彝珍，道光末進士，選庶吉士，改兵部主事。

translations.literal: Yizhen, a jinshi late in Daoguang, was selected as bachelor and changed to secretary in the Ministry of War.
translations.idiomatic: Yizhen, a jinshi late in Daoguang, was selected as bachelor and changed to secretary in the Ministry of War.

sentences.zh: 與曾國藩、左宗棠往還，好奔走聲氣。

translations.literal: He associated with Zeng Guofan and Zuo Zongtang and delighted in courting reputation and influence.
translations.idiomatic: He associated with Zeng Guofan and Zuo Zongtang and delighted in courting reputation and influence.

sentences.zh: 重宴鹿鳴，賞四品卿。

translations.literal: At the repeated banquet for former graduates he was rewarded with the fourth-rank insignia.
translations.idiomatic: At the repeated banquet for former graduates he was rewarded with fourth-rank insignia.

sentences.zh: 年九十餘，卒。

translations.literal: He died in his nineties.
translations.idiomatic: He died in his nineties.

sentences.zh: 有移芝室集。

translations.literal: He left the Yizhi Studio Collection.
translations.idiomatic: His collected works survive as the Yizhi Studio Collection.

sentences.zh: 周壽昌，字應甫，長沙人。

translations.literal: Zhou Shouchang, styled Yingfu, was a native of Changsha.
translations.idiomatic: Zhou Shouchang, styled Yingfu, was from Changsha.

sentences.zh: 道光二十五年進士，選庶吉士，授編修。

translations.literal: A jinshi in the twenty-fifth year of Daoguang, he was selected as bachelor and appointed Compiler.
translations.idiomatic: A jinshi in the twenty-fifth year of Daoguang (1845), he was selected as bachelor and appointed Hanlin Compiler.

sentences.zh: 咸豐初，洊擢至侍讀。

translations.literal: Early in Xianfeng he was promoted to reader.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Xianfeng reign he was promoted to reader in the Hanlin.

sentences.zh: 時粵寇犯湖南，督師賽尚阿逗遛不戰，上疏劾之，一時推為敢言。

translations.literal: When the Cantonese rebels invaded Hunan, Grand Commissioner Sai Shang'a delayed and would not fight; he memorialized impeachment and was for a time acclaimed for bold speech.
translations.idiomatic: When the Taiping rebels invaded Hunan, Grand Commissioner Sai Shang'a delayed and would not fight; Shouchang memorialized for his impeachment and was acclaimed for bold speech.

sentences.zh: 迨寇踞金陵，分黨北犯，命隨辦京畿防務。

translations.literal: When the rebels held Nanjing and sent parties north, he was ordered to assist in capital defenses.
translations.idiomatic: When the rebels held Nanjing and sent parties north, he was ordered to assist in capital defenses.

sentences.zh: 鄉民十七人闌入城，當事者偵獲，以賊諜論，壽昌廉得實，趣令釋之；

translations.literal: Seventeen villagers forced their way into the city; the authorities seized them as spies; Shouchang investigated and found the truth and urged their release;
translations.idiomatic: Seventeen villagers forced their way into the city; the authorities seized them as spies; Shouchang investigated, found the truth, and urged their release;

sentences.zh: 或疑失要人旨，且得罪，壽昌曰：「我豈以人命阿權貴哉？」

translations.literal: some suspected he would offend powerful persons and be punished; Shouchang said: "Would I curry favor with the powerful at the cost of human lives?"
translations.idiomatic: some feared he would offend powerful persons; Shouchang said, "Would I curry favor with the powerful at the cost of human lives?

sentences.zh: 卒釋之。

translations.literal: In the end they were released.
translations.idiomatic: In the end they were released.

sentences.zh: 穆宗親政，疏請躬行典禮，戒逸豫，報聞。

translations.literal: When the Muzong Emperor personally took power, he memorialized to perform rituals in person and guard against indulgence; the court acknowledged receipt.
translations.idiomatic: When the Tongzhi Emperor personally took power, he memorialized to perform rituals in person and guard against indulgence; the court acknowledged receipt.

sentences.zh: 壽昌精核強記，雖宦達，勤學過諸生。

translations.literal: Shouchang was precise and had a powerful memory; though an official he studied more diligently than students.
translations.idiomatic: Shouchang was precise and had a powerful memory; though an official he studied more diligently than students.

sentences.zh: 篤嗜班固書，塗染無隙紙，成漢書注校補五十卷，易藁十有七。

translations.literal: He was devoted to Ban Gu's History; with no blank space on the paper he completed fifty fascicles of Supplementary Collation and Commentary to the History of Han, changing drafts seventeen times.
translations.idiomatic: He was devoted to Ban Gu's History of Han; with no blank space on the paper he completed fifty fascicles of Supplementary Collation and Commentary, changing drafts seventeen times.

sentences.zh: 又有後漢注補正、三國志注證遺、思益堂集。

translations.literal: He also had Corrections and Supplements to the Commentary on the Later Han, Remnants of the Commentary on the Records of the Three Kingdoms, and the Siyi Hall Collection.
translations.idiomatic: He also wrote Corrections and Supplements to the Commentary on the Later Han, Remnants of the Commentary on the Records of the Three Kingdoms, and the Siyi Hall Collection.

sentences.zh: 官終內閣學士。

translations.literal: He ended as Grand Secretary of the Grand Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: He ended his career as Grand Secretary of the Grand Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 李希聖，字亦園，湘鄉人。

translations.literal: Li Xisheng, styled Yiyuan, was a native of Xiangxiang.
translations.idiomatic: Li Xisheng, styled Yiyuan, was from Xiangxiang.

sentences.zh: 以進士官刑部主事。

translations.literal: As a jinshi he served as secretary in the Ministry of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: As a jinshi he served as secretary in the Ministry of Punishments.

sentences.zh: 嗜學，初治訓詁，通周官、春秋、穀梁，史習新舊唐書，文法騷、選，詩多淒艷，似玉谿。

translations.literal: Devoted to learning, he first studied glosses, mastered the Offices of Zhou, the Spring and Autumn Annals, and Guliang, was versed in the old and new Books of Tang, modeled his prose on the Songs of Chu and Selections, and his poetry was often bleak and gorgeous, resembling Li Shangyin.
translations.idiomatic: Devoted to learning, he first studied glosses, mastered the Offices of Zhou, the Spring and Autumn Annals, and Guliang, was versed in the old and new Books of Tang, modeled his prose on the Songs of Chu and Wenxuan, and his poetry was often bleak and gorgeous, resembling Li Shangyin.

sentences.zh: 好讀書，通古今治法，慨然有經世之志。

translations.literal: He loved reading and was versed in methods of governance ancient and modern, with emotion cherishing the ambition to order the age.
translations.idiomatic: He loved reading, was versed in methods of governance ancient and modern, and cherished the ambition to order the age.

sentences.zh: 嘗纂光緒會計錄以總綜財賦。

translations.literal: He once compiled the Guangxu Accounting Records to synthesize state revenue.
translations.idiomatic: He once compiled the Guangxu Accounting Records to synthesize state revenue.

sentences.zh: 又草律例損益議，張百熙等皆極重之。

translations.literal: He also drafted Discussions on Gains and Losses in Statutes and Regulations; Zhang Boxi and others all esteemed him highly.
translations.idiomatic: He also drafted Discussions on Gains and Losses in Statutes and Regulations; Zhang Boxi and others all esteemed him highly.

sentences.zh: 光緒末，卒。

translations.literal: Late in Guangxu he died.
translations.idiomatic: Late in the Guangxu reign he died.

sentences.zh: 斌良，字笠畊，號梅舫，瓜爾佳氏，滿洲正紅旗人，閩浙總督玉德子。

translations.literal: Bin Liang, styled Liyun, styled Meifang, of the Guwalgiya clan, a Bannerman of the Plain Red, was son of Fujian-Zhejiang Governor-General Yude.
translations.idiomatic: Bin Liang, styled Liyun, also known as Meifang, of the Guwalgiya clan, a Manchu Bannerman of the Plain Red, was son of Fujian-Zhejiang Governor-General Yude.

sentences.zh: 由廕生歷官刑部侍郎，為駐藏大臣。

translations.literal: From a yinsheng he rose to vice minister in the Ministry of Punishments and served as resident minister in Tibet.
translations.idiomatic: From a yinsheng he rose to vice minister in the Ministry of Punishments and served as resident minister in Tibet.

sentences.zh: 善為詩，以一官為一集，得八千首。

translations.literal: Skilled at poetry, he made one collection for each post, obtaining eight thousand poems.
translations.idiomatic: Skilled at poetry, he made one collection for each post, producing eight thousand poems.

sentences.zh: 其弟法良彙刊為抱衝齋全集，稱其早年詩，風華典贍，雅近竹垞、樊榭。

translations.literal: His younger brother Faliang collected and published them as the Complete Works of the Baochong Studio, praising his early poetry as brilliant and elegant, close to Zhu Yizun and Li E.
translations.idiomatic: His younger brother Faliang collected and published them as the Complete Works of the Baochong Studio, praising his early poetry as brilliant and elegant, close to Zhu Yizun and Li E.

sentences.zh: 迨服官農部，從軍滅滑，詩格堅老。

translations.literal: When he took office in the Ministry of Revenue and followed the army to suppress the Huai rebellion, his poetic style grew firm and old.
translations.idiomatic: When he took office in the Ministry of Revenue and followed the army to suppress rebellion, his poetic style grew firm and mature.

sentences.zh: 古體胎息漢、魏、韓、杜、蘇、李，律詩則純法盛唐。

translations.literal: Ancient-style poetry drew breath from Han, Wei, Han Yu, Du Fu, Su Shi, and Li Bai; regulated verse purely followed the High Tang.
translations.idiomatic: His ancient-style poetry drew breath from Han, Wei, Han Yu, Du Fu, Su Shi, and Li Bai; his regulated verse purely followed the High Tang.

sentences.zh: 秉臬陝、豫，奉召還都，時與陳荔峰、李春湖、葉筠潭、吳蘭雪唱酬，詩境益高。

translations.literal: As provincial judge in Shaanxi and Henan he was recalled to the capital; at the time he exchanged poems with Chen Lifeng, Li Chunhu, Ye Yuntan, and Wu Lanxue, and his poetic realm grew higher.
translations.idiomatic: As provincial judge in Shaanxi and Henan he was recalled to the capital; he exchanged poems with Chen Lifeng, Li Chunhu, Ye Yuntan, and Wu Lanxue, and his poetic realm grew higher.

sentences.zh: 奉使蒙蕃，跋馬古塞，索隱探奇，多詩人未歷之境，風格又一變，以薩天錫、元遺山自況。

translations.literal: On mission to Mongolia he rode through ancient passes, seeking hidden wonders and exploring the strange—many realms poets had never traversed; his style changed again, comparing himself to Sa Dutong and Yuan Haoshan.
translations.idiomatic: On mission to Mongolia he rode through ancient passes, seeking hidden wonders—many realms poets had never traversed; his style changed again, and he compared himself to Sa Dutong and Yuan Haoshan.

sentences.zh: 阮元為序，亦頗稱之。

translations.literal: Ruan Yuan wrote a preface and also praised him considerably.
translations.idiomatic: Ruan Yuan wrote a preface and praised him highly.

sentences.zh: 法良，字可盦。

translations.literal: Faliang, styled Ke'an.
translations.idiomatic: Faliang, styled Ke'an.

sentences.zh: 梅曾亮稱其詩學東坡，得清曠之氣，而運以唐賢優游平夷之情。

translations.literal: Mei Cengliang said his poetry studied Su Dongpo, obtaining clear spaciousness and tempering it with the Tang masters' leisurely, level ease.
translations.idiomatic: Mei Cengliang said his poetry studied Su Dongpo, obtaining clear spaciousness tempered with the Tang masters' leisurely ease.

sentences.zh: 有《漚羅盦詩集》。

translations.literal: He had the Ouluo'an Poetry Collection.
translations.idiomatic: His Ouluo'an Poetry Collection survives.

sentences.zh: 錫縝，原名錫淳，字厚安，博爾濟吉特氏，滿洲正藍旗人。

translations.literal: Xi Zhen, original name Xichun, styled Hou'an, of the Borjigit clan, a Bannerman of the Plain Blue.
translations.idiomatic: Xi Zhen, original name Xichun, styled Hou'an, of the Borjigit clan, a Manchu Bannerman of the Plain Blue.

sentences.zh: 咸豐六年進士。

translations.literal: A jinshi in the sixth year of Xianfeng.
translations.idiomatic: A jinshi in the sixth year of Xianfeng (1856).

sentences.zh: 由戶部郎中授江西督糧道，為駐藏大臣，乞病歸。

translations.literal: From director in the Ministry of Revenue he was appointed Jiangxi grain commissioner, served as resident minister in Tibet, and pleaded illness to return home.
translations.idiomatic: From director in the Ministry of Revenue he was appointed Jiangxi grain commissioner, served as resident minister in Tibet, and pleaded illness to return home.

sentences.zh: 工書，善詩文。

translations.literal: Skilled at calligraphy, he was good at poetry and prose.
translations.idiomatic: Skilled at calligraphy, he was accomplished in poetry and prose.

sentences.zh: 著有《退复軒詩文集》。

translations.literal: He authored the Tuifu Studio Poetry and Prose Collection.
translations.idiomatic: His Tuifu Studio Poetry and Prose Collection survives.

sentences.zh: 李雲麟，字雨蒼，漢軍正白旗人。

translations.literal: Li Yunlin, styled Yu'ang, was a Han Bannerman of the Plain White.
translations.idiomatic: Li Yunlin, styled Yu'ang, was a Han Bannerman of the Plain White.

sentences.zh: 以諸生從曾國藩督師剿粵匪，累功至副都統。

translations.literal: As a student he followed Zeng Guofan in suppressing the Cantonese rebels, accumulating merit to vice commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: As a student he followed Zeng Guofan in suppressing the Taiping rebels, rising to vice commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 時新疆設布倫託海辦事大臣，以雲麟任之。

translations.literal: At the time Xinjiang established the Buluntuohai frontier commissioner; Yunlin was appointed to the post.
translations.idiomatic: When Xinjiang established the Buluntuohai frontier commissioner, Yunlin was appointed to the post.

sentences.zh: 署伊犁將軍。

translations.literal: He served as acting Ili general.
translations.idiomatic: He served as acting Ili general.

sentences.zh: 治邊皆著績，為言官劾罷。

translations.literal: In governing the frontier he achieved merit, but was impeached and dismissed by censors.
translations.idiomatic: In governing the frontier he achieved merit, but censors impeached him and he was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 雲麟性剛使氣，少好遊，遍歷五嶽，歸著《曠遊偶筆》一卷。

translations.literal: Yunlin was by nature stubborn and high-spirited; in youth he loved travel, traversing the five sacred mountains, and on returning wrote one fascicle of Casual Notes of Vast Travel.
translations.idiomatic: Yunlin was stubborn and high-spirited; in youth he traveled the five sacred mountains and wrote Casual Notes of Vast Travel in one fascicle.

sentences.zh: 紀遊詩有奇氣。

translations.literal: His travel poetry had an uncommon spirit.
translations.idiomatic: His travel poetry had an uncommon spirit.

sentences.zh: 初謁國藩，適遇其子不為禮，雲麟怒批之。

translations.literal: On first visiting Guofan he happened to meet Guofan's son, who was discourteous; Yunlin angrily rebuked him.
translations.idiomatic: On first visiting Guofan he met Guofan's son, who was discourteous; Yunlin angrily rebuked him.

sentences.zh: 國藩延入謝過，使獨領一軍。

translations.literal: Guofan invited him in and apologized, letting him command an army alone.
translations.idiomatic: Guofan invited him in, apologized, and let him command an army alone.

sentences.zh: 左宗棠奏調，亦稱其有將才。

translations.literal: Zuo Zongtang memorialized to transfer him and also praised his talent as a general.
translations.idiomatic: Zuo Zongtang memorialized to transfer him and also praised his talent as a general.

sentences.zh: 雲麟時被酒狂言，與世多忤。

translations.literal: Yunlin often spoke wildly when drunk and clashed with the world.
translations.idiomatic: Yunlin often spoke wildly when drunk and clashed with the world.

sentences.zh: 罷歸後，卒貧困死。

translations.literal: After dismissal and return he died in poverty.
translations.idiomatic: After dismissal and return he died in poverty.

sentences.zh: 有詩集，《西陲紀行》。

translations.literal: He left a poetry collection and Record of a Journey to the Western Marches.
translations.idiomatic: He left a poetry collection and Record of a Journey to the Western Marches.

sentences.zh: 道、咸以來，滿洲如觀成，字葦杭，瓜爾佳氏。

translations.literal: Since Daoguang and Xianfeng, among Manchus there was Guan Cheng, styled Weihang, of the Guwalgiya clan.
translations.idiomatic: Since the Daoguang and Xianfeng reigns, among Manchus there was Guan Cheng of the Guwalgiya clan, styled Weihang.

sentences.zh: 有《瓜亭雜錄》、《語花館詩集》。

translations.literal: He had the Guating Miscellany and the Yuhua Hall Poetry Collection.
translations.idiomatic: His works include the Guating Miscellany and the Yuhua Hall Poetry Collection.

sentences.zh: 鄂恆，字松亭，伊爾根覺羅氏。

translations.literal: E Heng, styled Songting, of the Irgen Gioro clan.
translations.idiomatic: E Heng, styled Songting, of the Irgen Gioro clan.

sentences.zh: 有《求是山房集》。

translations.literal: He had the Qiushi Mountain Studio Collection.
translations.idiomatic: His Qiushi Mountain Studio Collection survives.

sentences.zh: 震鈞，字在廷，改名唐宴，瓜爾佳氏。

translations.literal: Zhen Jun, styled Zaiting, later renamed Tang Yan, of the Guwalgiya clan.
translations.idiomatic: Zhen Jun, styled Zaiting, later renamed Tang Yan, of the Guwalgiya clan.

sentences.zh: 有《渤海國志》、《天咫偶聞》。

translations.literal: He had the Annals of the Bohai Kingdom and Casual Hearings from Heaven's Reach.
translations.idiomatic: His works include the Annals of the Bohai Kingdom and Casual Hearings from Heaven's Reach.

sentences.zh: 英華，字斂之，赫佳氏，正紅旗人。

translations.literal: Ying Hua, styled Lianzhi, of the Hejia clan, a Bannerman of the Plain Red.
translations.idiomatic: Ying Hua, styled Lianzhi, of the Hejia clan, a Manchu Bannerman of the Plain Red.

sentences.zh: 博學善詩文，工書法。

translations.literal: Broadly learned, skilled at poetry and prose, expert in calligraphy.
translations.idiomatic: Broadly learned, he was skilled at poetry and prose and expert in calligraphy.

sentences.zh: 著書立說，中外知名。

translations.literal: In writing books and establishing doctrines he was renowned at home and abroad.
translations.idiomatic: Through his books and doctrines he was renowned at home and abroad.

sentences.zh: 有《安蹇齋集》、《萬松野人言善錄》等。

translations.literal: He had the Anjian Studio Collection, Records of the Old Man of Ten Thousand Pines, and others.
translations.idiomatic: His works include the Anjian Studio Collection and Records of the Old Man of Ten Thousand Pines.

sentences.zh: 蒙古盛元，字愷廷，巴魯特氏。

translations.literal: The Mongol Sheng Yuan, styled Kaiting, of the Balut clan.
translations.idiomatic: The Mongol Sheng Yuan of the Balut clan, styled Kaiting.

sentences.zh: 有《南昌府志》、《杭營小志》、《怡園詩草》。

translations.literal: He had the Gazetteer of Nanchang Prefecture, Brief Account of the Hang Camp, and Yiyuan Poetry Drafts.
translations.idiomatic: His works include the Gazetteer of Nanchang Prefecture, Brief Account of the Hang Camp, and Yiyuan Poetry Drafts.

sentences.zh: 漢軍宗​​山，字歗梧，魯氏。

translations.literal: The Han Bannerman Zongshan, styled Xiaowu, of the Lu clan.
translations.idiomatic: The Han Bannerman Zongshan of the Lu clan, styled Xiaowu.

sentences.zh: 有《窺生鐵齋詩集》、《希晦堂遺文》。

translations.literal: He had the Kuisheng Iron Studio Poetry Collection and Posthumous Writings of the Xihui Hall.
translations.idiomatic: His works include the Kuisheng Iron Studio Poetry Collection and Posthumous Writings of the Xihui Hall.

sentences.zh: 皆以詩文名。

translations.literal: All were famed for poetry and prose.
translations.idiomatic: All were famed for poetry and prose.

sentences.zh: 何紹基，字子貞，道州人，尚書凌漢子。

translations.literal: He Shaoji, styled Zizhen, was a native of Daozhou, son of Minister Ling Han.
translations.idiomatic: He Shaoji, styled Zizhen, was from Daozhou, son of Minister Ling Han.

sentences.zh: 道光十六年進士，選庶吉士，授編修。

translations.literal: A jinshi in the sixteenth year of Daoguang, he was selected as bachelor and appointed Compiler.
translations.idiomatic: A jinshi in the sixteenth year of Daoguang (1836), he was selected as bachelor and appointed Hanlin Compiler.

sentences.zh: 紹基承家學，少有名。

translations.literal: Shaoji inherited family learning and was famed from youth.
translations.idiomatic: Shaoji inherited family learning and was famed from youth.

sentences.zh: 阮元、程恩澤頗器賞之。

translations.literal: Ruan Yuan and Cheng Enze greatly valued him.
translations.idiomatic: Ruan Yuan and Cheng Enze greatly valued him.

sentences.zh: 歷典福建、貴州、廣東鄉試，均稱得人。

translations.literal: He presided over the provincial examinations of Fujian, Guizhou, and Guangdong, each time praised for selecting worthy men.
translations.idiomatic: He presided over the provincial examinations of Fujian, Guizhou, and Guangdong, each time praised for selecting worthy candidates.

sentences.zh: 咸豐二年，簡四川學政。

translations.literal: In the second year of Xianfeng he was selected as educational commissioner of Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Xianfeng (1852) he was selected as educational commissioner of Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 召對，詢家世學業，兼及時務。

translations.literal: Summoned for audience, he was asked about family background and studies, and also current affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Summoned for audience, he was asked about family background, studies, and current affairs.

sentences.zh: 紹基感激，思立言報知遇，時直陳地方情形，終以條陳時務降歸。

translations.literal: Shaoji was moved and wished to repay imperial favor by establishing doctrine; he frankly stated local conditions and in the end was demoted for memorializing on current affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Shaoji was moved and wished to repay imperial favor; he frankly stated local conditions and was eventually demoted for memorializing on current affairs.

sentences.zh: 歷主山東濼源、長沙城南書院，教授生徒，勗以實學。

translations.literal: He successively headed the Luoyuan Academy in Shandong and the Chengnan Academy in Changsha, teaching students and urging practical learning.
translations.idiomatic: He headed the Luoyuan Academy in Shandong and the Chengnan Academy in Changsha, teaching students and urging practical learning.

sentences.zh: 同治十三年，卒，年七十又五。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year of Tongzhi he died at seventy-five.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year of Tongzhi (1874) he died at seventy-five.

sentences.zh: 紹基通經史，精律算。

translations.literal: Shaoji was versed in the classics and histories and expert in musical temperament and calculation.
translations.idiomatic: Shaoji was versed in the classics and histories and expert in musical temperament and calculation.

sentences.zh: 嘗據大戴記考證禮經，貫通制度，頗精切。

translations.literal: He once used the Elder Dai's Records to verify the Ritual Classics, penetrating institutions with considerable precision.
translations.idiomatic: He once used the Elder Dai's Records to verify the Ritual Classics, penetrating institutions with considerable precision.

sentences.zh: 又為水經註刊誤。

translations.literal: He also corrected errors in the Commentary on the Water Classic.
translations.idiomatic: He also corrected errors in Li Daoyuan's Commentary on the Water Classic.

sentences.zh: 於說文考訂尤深。

translations.literal: His examination of the Shuowen was especially deep.
translations.idiomatic: His examination of the Shuowen was especially deep.

sentences.zh: 詩類黃庭堅。

translations.literal: His poetry resembled Huang Tingjian's.
translations.idiomatic: His poetry resembled Huang Tingjian's.

sentences.zh: 嗜金石，精書法。

translations.literal: He loved bronzes and stones and was expert in calligraphy.
translations.idiomatic: He loved antiquities and was expert in calligraphy.

sentences.zh: 初學顏真卿，遍臨漢、魏各碑至百十過。

translations.literal: At first he studied Yan Zhenqing, then traced Han and Wei steles more than a hundred times each.
translations.idiomatic: At first he studied Yan Zhenqing, then traced Han and Wei steles more than a hundred times each.

sentences.zh: 運肘斂指，心摹手追，遂自成一家，世皆重之。

translations.literal: Moving the elbow and drawing in the fingers, heart copying and hand pursuing, he formed a school of his own, and the age all prized him.
translations.idiomatic: With controlled elbow and fingers, heart and hand in pursuit, he formed a school of his own, and the age prized him.

sentences.zh: 所著有東洲詩文集四十卷。

translations.literal: His works include the Dongzhou Poetry and Prose Collection in forty fascicles.
translations.idiomatic: His Dongzhou Poetry and Prose Collection runs to forty fascicles.

sentences.zh: 弟紹京，字子愚。

translations.literal: His younger brother Shaojing, styled Ziyu.
translations.idiomatic: His younger brother Shaojing, styled Ziyu.

sentences.zh: 亦工書，筆法頗似其兄。

translations.literal: Also skilled at calligraphy, his brush manner resembled his elder brother's.
translations.idiomatic: Also skilled at calligraphy, his brush manner resembled his brother's.

sentences.zh: 孫維樸，字詩孫。

translations.literal: Sun Weipu, styled Shisun.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Weipu, styled Shisun.

sentences.zh: 以副貢為中書，累至道員。

translations.literal: As a tribute student from the second list he became a Secretariat compiler and rose to circuit intendant.
translations.idiomatic: As a tribute student from the second list he became a Secretariat compiler and rose to circuit intendant.

sentences.zh: 工書畫，字摹其祖。

translations.literal: Skilled at calligraphy and painting, his characters imitated his grandfather's.
translations.idiomatic: Skilled at calligraphy and painting, his characters imitated his grandfather's.

sentences.zh: 久寓滬，國變後，卒，年八十餘。

translations.literal: Long resident in Shanghai, after the dynastic change he died in his eighties.
translations.idiomatic: Long resident in Shanghai, after the dynastic change he died in his eighties.

sentences.zh: 與維樸同時以書名海上者李瑞清，字梅盦，臨川人。

translations.literal: Contemporary with Weipu and famed for calligraphy in Shanghai was Li Ruiqing, styled Meian, a native of Linchuan.
translations.idiomatic: Contemporary with Weipu and famed for calligraphy in Shanghai was Li Ruiqing of Linchuan, styled Meian.

sentences.zh: 光緒二十年進士，選庶吉士。

translations.literal: A jinshi in the twentieth year of Guangxu, he was selected as bachelor.
translations.idiomatic: A jinshi in the twentieth year of Guangxu (1894), he was selected as bachelor.

sentences.zh: 改道員，分江蘇，攝江寧提學使，兼兩江師範學堂監督。

translations.literal: Changed to circuit intendant, assigned to Jiangsu, acting Jiangning educational commissioner and concurrently supervising the Liangjiang Normal School.
translations.idiomatic: Changed to circuit intendant in Jiangsu, he served as acting Jiangning educational commissioner and concurrently supervised the Liangjiang Normal School.

sentences.zh: 宣統三年，武昌亂起，江寧新軍亦變，合浙軍攻城。

translations.literal: In the third year of Xuantong rebellion broke out in Wuchang and the Jiangning New Army also mutinied, joining Zhejiang troops to attack the city.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Xuantong (1911) rebellion broke out in Wuchang and the Jiangning New Army mutinied, joining Zhejiang troops to attack the city.

sentences.zh: 官吏潛遁，瑞清獨留不去，仍日率諸生上課如常。

translations.literal: Officials fled in secret; Ruiqing alone stayed and did not leave, still daily leading students to class as usual.
translations.idiomatic: Officials fled in secret; Ruiqing alone stayed, still daily leading students to class as usual.

sentences.zh: 布政使樊增祥棄職走，以瑞清代之。

translations.literal: Financial Commissioner Fan Zengxiang abandoned his post and fled; Ruiqing acted in his place.
translations.idiomatic: Financial Commissioner Fan Zengxiang abandoned his post and fled; Ruiqing acted in his place.

sentences.zh: 急購米三十萬斛餉官軍，助城守，設平糶局，賑難民。

translations.literal: He urgently purchased three hundred thousand piculs of rice to supply the government army, aided in defending the city, and established fair-price granaries to relieve refugees.
translations.idiomatic: He urgently purchased three hundred thousand piculs of rice to supply the government army, aided in defending the city, and established fair-price granaries to relieve refugees.

sentences.zh: 城陷，瑞清衣冠坐堂皇，矢死不少屈。

translations.literal: When the city fell Ruiqing sat in full dress in the hall and died from arrows without yielding.
translations.idiomatic: When the city fell Ruiqing sat in full dress in the hall and died from arrows without yielding.

sentences.zh: 民軍不忍加害，縱之行。

translations.literal: The revolutionary army could not bear to harm him and let him go.
translations.idiomatic: The revolutionary army could not bear to harm him and let him go.

sentences.zh: 乃封藩庫，以鑰與籍囑之士紳，積金尚數十萬也。

translations.literal: He then sealed the provincial treasury, entrusting keys and registers to gentry; accumulated gold still amounted to several hundred thousand.
translations.idiomatic: He then sealed the provincial treasury, entrusting keys and registers to local gentry; accumulated gold still amounted to several hundred thousand taels.

sentences.zh: 自是為道士裝，隱滬上，匿姓名，自署曰「清道人」，鬻書畫以自活。

translations.literal: Thereafter in Taoist dress he hid in Shanghai, concealing his name and styling himself the Qing Daoist, selling calligraphy and painting to live.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter in Taoist dress he hid in Shanghai, concealing his name and styling himself the Qing Daoist, selling calligraphy and painting to live.

sentences.zh: 瑞清詩宗漢、魏，下涉陶、謝。

translations.literal: Ruiqing's poetry followed Han and Wei, extending down to Tao Yuanming and Xie Lingyun.
translations.idiomatic: Ruiqing's poetry followed Han and Wei, extending down to Tao Yuanming and Xie Lingyun.

sentences.zh: 書各體皆備，尤好篆隸。

translations.literal: In calligraphy he mastered every style, especially loving seal and clerical script.
translations.idiomatic: In calligraphy he mastered every style, especially loving seal and clerical script.

sentences.zh: 嘗謂作篆必目無二李，神遊三代乃佳。

translations.literal: He once said that in writing seal script the eye must see no Li Yangbing, the spirit roaming the Three Dynasties, to be excellent.
translations.idiomatic: He once said that in writing seal script one must see no Li Yangbing and let the spirit roam the Three Dynasties to achieve excellence.

sentences.zh: 丁巳復闢，授學部侍郎。

translations.literal: In the dingsi year he was restored and appointed vice minister of the Ministry of Education.
translations.idiomatic: In the dingsi year (1917) he was restored and appointed vice minister of the Ministry of Education.

sentences.zh: 又三年卒，諡文潔。

translations.literal: Three years later he died, posthumously titled Wenjie.
translations.idiomatic: Three years later he died, posthumously titled Wenjie.

sentences.zh: 馮桂芬，字林一，號景亭，吳縣人。

translations.literal: Feng Guifen, styled Linyi, styled Jingting, was a native of Wu County.
translations.idiomatic: Feng Guifen, styled Linyi, also known as Jingting, was from Wu County.

sentences.zh: 道光二十年一甲二名進士，授編修，充廣西鄉試正考官，丁母憂。

translations.literal: Second in the first rank in the twentieth year of Daoguang, he was appointed Compiler and served as chief examiner of the Guangxi provincial examination, then mourned his mother.
translations.idiomatic: Second in the first rank in the twentieth year of Daoguang (1840), he was appointed Hanlin Compiler, served as chief examiner of the Guangxi provincial examination, then mourned his mother.

sentences.zh: 服闋，文宗御極，用大臣薦召見。

translations.literal: When mourning ended, on the Wenzong Emperor's accession he was summoned on grand ministers' recommendation.
translations.idiomatic: When mourning ended, on the Xianfeng Emperor's accession he was summoned on grand ministers' recommendation.

sentences.zh: 旋丁父憂，服甫闋而金陵陷。

translations.literal: Soon he mourned his father; when mourning had just ended Nanjing fell.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he mourned his father; when mourning had just ended Nanjing fell.

sentences.zh: 詔募貲團練於鄉，以克復松江府諸城功晉五品銜，擢右中允。

translations.literal: An edict ordered raising funds for militia in his district; for recovering the prefectures of Songjiang he was promoted to fifth rank and elevated to right censor.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered raising funds for militia in his district; for recovering Songjiang prefecture he was promoted to fifth rank and elevated to right censor.

sentences.zh: 赴京，期年告歸。

translations.literal: He went to the capital; within a year he requested leave and returned home.
translations.idiomatic: He went to the capital; within a year he requested leave and returned home.

sentences.zh: 同治元年，以治團功加四品銜。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tongzhi he was given fourth rank for militia achievements.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Tongzhi (1862) he was given fourth rank for militia achievements.

sentences.zh: 亂定，復以耆宿著書裨治加三品銜。

translations.literal: When rebellion was settled he was again given third rank as an elder whose writings aided governance.
translations.idiomatic: When rebellion was settled he was again given third rank as an elder whose writings aided governance.

sentences.zh: 桂芬少工駢體文，中年後乃肆力古文辭。

translations.literal: Guifen in youth was skilled at parallel prose; after midlife he devoted himself to ancient-style prose.
translations.idiomatic: Guifen in youth was skilled at parallel prose; after midlife he devoted himself to ancient-style prose.

sentences.zh: 於書無所不窺，尤留意天文、地輿、兵刑、鹽鐵、河漕諸政。

translations.literal: In books there was nothing he did not examine; he especially attended to astronomy, geography, military punishment, salt and iron, and grain transport policies.
translations.idiomatic: There was no book he did not examine; he especially attended to astronomy, geography, military affairs, salt and iron, and grain transport.

sentences.zh: 初佐某邑令治錢穀，以事不合拂衣去，入兩江總督陶澍幕。

translations.literal: At first he assisted a district magistrate in managing revenue; when matters did not agree he flung his robe and left, entering the staff of Liangjiang Governor-General Tao Shu.
translations.idiomatic: At first he assisted a district magistrate in managing revenue; when matters did not agree he resigned and entered the staff of Liangjiang Governor-General Tao Shu.

sentences.zh: 自未仕時已名重大江南北。

translations.literal: Even before office his fame was great north and south of the Yangtze.
translations.idiomatic: Even before taking office his fame was great throughout the Yangtze valley.

sentences.zh: 及粵賊陷蘇州，避居上海。

translations.literal: When Cantonese rebels took Suzhou he fled to Shanghai.
translations.idiomatic: When the Taiping rebels took Suzhou he fled to Shanghai.

sentences.zh: 時大學士曾國藩治軍皖疆。

translations.literal: At the time Grand Secretary Zeng Guofan was commanding armies in Anhui.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Grand Secretary Zeng Guofan was commanding armies in Anhui.

sentences.zh: 蘇州士大夫推錢鼎銘持書乞援，陳滬城危狀，及用兵機宜，累數千言，其稿，桂芬所手創也。

translations.literal: Suzhou scholar-officials urged Qian Dingming to carry a letter begging aid, stating Shanghai's peril and military opportunities in several thousand words—the draft was Guifen's own composition.
translations.idiomatic: Suzhou scholars urged Qian Dingming to carry a letter begging aid, stating Shanghai's peril and military opportunities in several thousand words—the draft was Guifen's own work.

sentences.zh: 國藩讀之感動，乃遣李鴻章率師東下。

translations.literal: Guofan, reading it, was moved and thereupon sent Li Hongzhang east with an army.
translations.idiomatic: Guofan, reading it, was moved and sent Li Hongzhang east with an army.

sentences.zh: 既解滬上圍，進克蘇州，皆闢以為助。

translations.literal: After the siege of Shanghai was lifted and Suzhou was taken, all attributed the help to him.
translations.idiomatic: After the siege of Shanghai was lifted and Suzhou was taken, all attributed the help to him.

sentences.zh: 桂芬立會防局，調和中外雜處者。

translations.literal: Guifen established the Joint Defense Bureau to harmonize Chinese and foreigners living together.
translations.idiomatic: Guifen established the Joint Defense Bureau to harmonize Chinese and foreigners living together.

sentences.zh: 設廣方言館，求博通西學之才，儲以濟變。

translations.literal: He founded the School of Foreign Languages, seeking talent thoroughly versed in Western learning to store up for change.
translations.idiomatic: He founded the School of Foreign Languages, seeking talent versed in Western learning to meet coming change.

sentences.zh: 嘗從容為鴻章言吳人糧重之苦，往往因催科破家。

translations.literal: He once calmly told Hongzhang of the Wu people's suffering from heavy grain taxes, often ruined by tax collection.
translations.idiomatic: He once calmly told Hongzhang of the Wu people's suffering from heavy grain taxes, often ruined by tax collection.

sentences.zh: 會松江知府方傳書亦上書，謂：「江蘇自南宋籍沒諸王大臣田，官徵其租，延及元代，官田民田淆亂，租額浸淫入賦額，民既苦之；

translations.literal: At the time Songjiang Prefect Fang Chuanshu also memorialized, saying: "In Jiangsu since the Southern Song confiscated fields of princes and great ministers, the government collected their rent; this extended into the Yuan, official and private fields were confused, and rent amounts gradually seeped into tax quotas, to the people's bitter cost;
translations.idiomatic: At the time Songjiang Prefect Fang Chuanshu also memorialized, saying, "In Jiangsu since the Southern Song confiscated fields of princes and great ministers, the government collected their rent; under the Yuan official and private fields were confused, rent seeped into tax quotas, and the people suffered bitterly;

sentences.zh: 其後張士誠又盡攘諸豪田為官產，明太祖平吳，怒吳人附士誠，依田租私籍數定稅，乃重困。

translations.literal: later Zhang Shicheng seized all powerful families' fields as government property; when the Ming founder pacified Wu, angered that Wu people had followed Shicheng, he fixed tax by private land registers, and distress grew heavier.
translations.idiomatic: later Zhang Shicheng seized powerful families' fields as government property; when the Ming founder pacified Wu, angered that Wu people had followed Shicheng, he fixed tax by private land registers, and distress grew heavier.

sentences.zh: 雍正、乾隆間，嘗再議減，然但及地丁。

translations.literal: Under Yongzheng and Qianlong reduction was twice discussed, yet only land and poll taxes were touched.
translations.idiomatic: Under Yongzheng and Qianlong reduction was twice discussed, yet only land and poll taxes were touched.

sentences.zh: 今儻乘民亂後覈減浮糧，疲民大悅，賊勢且益衰。」

translations.literal: Now if after the people's rebellion floating grain tax were verified and reduced, the weary people would rejoice greatly and rebel strength would decline all the more."
translations.idiomatic: Now if after the rebellion floating grain tax were verified and reduced, the weary people would rejoice and rebel strength would decline.

sentences.zh: 鴻章以聞。

translations.literal: Hongzhang reported it.
translations.idiomatic: Hongzhang reported it to the throne.

sentences.zh: 有詔減蘇、松、太米賦三之一，常、鎮十一，著為令。

translations.literal: An edict reduced Suzhou, Songjiang, and Taicang rice tax by one-third and Changzhou and Zhenjiang by one-eleventh, established as statute.
translations.idiomatic: An edict reduced Suzhou, Songjiang, and Taicang rice tax by one-third and Changzhou and Zhenjiang by one-eleventh, establishing it as statute.

sentences.zh: 桂芬性恬澹，服官僅十年，然家居遇事奮發，不避勞怨。

translations.literal: Guifen was by nature tranquil; he served only ten years, yet at home he rose to action and did not shun toil or blame.
translations.idiomatic: Guifen was by nature tranquil; he served only ten years, yet at home he rose to action and did not shun toil or blame.

sentences.zh: 凡濬河、建學、積穀諸舉，條議皆出其手。

translations.literal: Whether dredging rivers, building schools, or storing grain—all proposals came from his hand.
translations.idiomatic: Whether dredging rivers, building schools, or storing grain—all proposals came from his hand.

sentences.zh: 先後主講金陵、上海、蘇州諸書院，與後進論學，昕夕忘倦。

translations.literal: He successively lectured at academies in Jinling, Shanghai, and Suzhou, discussing learning with juniors morning and evening without weariness.
translations.idiomatic: He lectured at academies in Jinling, Shanghai, and Suzhou, discussing learning with juniors morning and evening without weariness.

sentences.zh: 精研書數，嘗以意造定向尺及反羅經，以步田繪圖。

translations.literal: He deeply studied mathematics and once devised by intent a directional ruler and reverse compass to measure fields and draw maps.
translations.idiomatic: He deeply studied mathematics and devised a directional ruler and reverse compass to measure fields and draw maps.

sentences.zh: 又以江南清丈用部頒五尺步弓，田多溢額，乃考會典定用舊行六尺步弓量舊田，新頒者量新漲沙田。

translations.literal: Because Jiangnan land surveys used the ministry's five-foot step bow and fields often exceeded quota, he investigated the Collected Statutes and fixed use of the old six-foot step bow for old fields and the new issue for newly silted fields.
translations.idiomatic: Because Jiangnan land surveys used the ministry's five-foot step bow and fields often exceeded quota, he investigated the Collected Statutes and fixed use of the old six-foot step bow for old fields and the new issue for newly silted fields.

sentences.zh: 著說文解字段注考證、弧矢算術細草圖解、西算新法直解、校邠廬抗議、顯志堂詩文集，都數十卷。

translations.literal: He authored Textual Verification of Duan Yucai's Commentary on the Shuowen, Detailed Explanations with Diagrams of Arc and Arrow Calculation, Direct Explanation of New Western Calculation Methods, Protests from the Jiaobin Studio, and the Xianzhi Hall Poetry and Prose Collection—in all several dozen fascicles.
translations.idiomatic: His works include Textual Verification of Duan Yucai's Commentary on the Shuowen, Detailed Explanations with Diagrams of Arc and Arrow Calculation, Direct Explanation of New Western Calculation Methods, Protests from the Jiaobin Studio, and the Xianzhi Hall Poetry and Prose Collection—in all several dozen fascicles.

sentences.zh: 同治十三年，卒。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year of Tongzhi he died.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year of Tongzhi (1874) he died.

sentences.zh: 王頌蔚，字芾卿，長洲人。

translations.literal: Wang Songwei, styled Fuqing, was a native of Changzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Songwei, styled Fuqing, was from Changzhou.

sentences.zh: 光緒五年進士，選庶吉士。

translations.literal: A jinshi in the fifth year of Guangxu, he was selected as bachelor.
translations.idiomatic: A jinshi in the fifth year of Guangxu (1879), he was selected as bachelor.

sentences.zh: 吳縣潘祖廕、常熟翁同龢皆稱頌蔚才。

translations.literal: Wu County's Pan Zuyin and Changshu's Weng Tonghe both praised Songwei's talent.
translations.idiomatic: Pan Zuyin of Wu County and Weng Tonghe of Changshu both praised Songwei's talent.

sentences.zh: 散館，改官戶部，補軍機章京。

translations.literal: Leaving the Hanlin, he changed to the Ministry of Revenue and was made up as clerk in the Grand Council.
translations.idiomatic: Leaving the Hanlin, he transferred to the Ministry of Revenue and was made up as clerk in the Grand Council.

sentences.zh: 暇輒從事著述。

translations.literal: In leisure he devoted himself to writing.
translations.idiomatic: In his leisure he devoted himself to writing.

sentences.zh: 嘗於方略館故紙堆中見殿板初印明史殘本，眉上黏有黃簽，審為乾隆朝擬撰考證未竟之本。

translations.literal: He once saw in a pile of old papers at the Strategy Office a damaged first palace edition of the History of Ming; yellow slips pasted on the margins proved to be drafts of textual verification planned in the Qianlong reign but unfinished.
translations.idiomatic: He once found in a pile of old papers at the Strategy Office a damaged first palace edition of the History of Ming; yellow slips on the margins proved to be unfinished Qianlong-era drafts of textual verification.

sentences.zh: 因多方搜求，逐條釐訂，芟其繁冗，採其精要，成明史考證攟逸四十餘卷。

translations.literal: He thereupon searched widely, revised item by item, cut redundancy, selected essentials, and produced more than forty fascicles of Gathered Remnants of Textual Verification of the History of Ming.
translations.idiomatic: He searched widely, revised item by item, cut redundancy, selected essentials, and produced more than forty fascicles of Gathered Remnants of Textual Verification of the History of Ming.

sentences.zh: 光緒十八年，試御史第一，軍機處奏留。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year of Guangxu he placed first in the censor examination; the Grand Council memorialized to retain him.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year of Guangxu (1892) he placed first in the censor examination; the Grand Council memorialized to retain him.

sentences.zh: 頌蔚思立言抒忠讜，轉鬱鬱不樂。

translations.literal: Songwei wished to establish doctrine and express loyal remonstrance, yet turned depressed and unhappy.
translations.idiomatic: Songwei wished to establish doctrine and express loyal remonstrance, yet grew depressed and unhappy.

sentences.zh: 嘗派充工程監督差，例有分饋，頌蔚獨卻之，曰：「我輩取與之間，貴自審慎，不可隨俗浮沉。

translations.literal: Once assigned to supervise engineering, by precedent there were shares to distribute; Songwei alone refused, saying: "In what we take and give, we must be careful ourselves and cannot drift with custom.
